description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractCommandSignalMapper' that provides a base implementation for mapping command signals to topic paths in a messaging protocol within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing topic paths based on commands, supported actions, and channels, and handles command-specific exceptions.

classes.name: AbstractCommandSignalMapper
classes.description: An abstract class serving as the base for SignalMapper implementations for command signals, providing common logic for topic path construction and command handling.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the TopicPath for a given command signal and channel.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain a TopicPathBuilder for the specified command.

methods.name: getSupportedActions
methods.description: Abstract method to specify which actions are supported by the command mapper.

methods.name: setTopicPathAction
methods.description: Sets the action on the CommandsTopicPathBuilder based on the command's class name and supported actions.

methods.name: unknownCommandException
methods.description: Creates a runtime exception indicating an unknown command, with different exception types for responses and other signals.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the appropriate action on the CommandsTopicPathBuilder based on the provided action enum.
